name: Valkyrie
text: Setup: The enemy team finds and attaches Shieldmaiden to Valkyrie. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Valkyrie attacks, if Death-Glow is in play, Valkyrie attacks the character with Death-Glow attached → this attack gains overkill.

name: Valkyrie
text: Steady. When Revealed: Deal each player an encounter card. Valkyrie cannot take damage this phase. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Valkyrie attacks, if Death-Glow is in play, Valkyrie attacks the character with Death-Glow attached → this attack gains overkill.

name: Death-Glow
text: Permanent. Attacks against attached character gain overkill. Forced Interrupt: When attached character is defeated, flip this card and attach it to Valkyrie.

name: Shieldmaiden
text: Permanent. Attach to Valkyrie. Valkyrie gains Retaliate 1. Forced Response: After an ally enters play, flip this card and attach it to that ally.

name: Valkyrie's Spear
text:
Attach to Valkyrie. When Valkyrie would take any amount of damage, reduce that damage by 1. Hero Response: After you make a basic attack against Valkyrie, give Valkyrie a tough status card → discard this card.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

name: Dragonfang
text:
Attach to Valkyrie. Valkyrie's attacks gain piercing. Hero Action: Spend three resources of the same type → discard this attachment.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

name: Flight Of The Valkyrior
text:
Attach to Valkyrie. Valkyrie gains stalwart. Forced Response: After an ally with Death-Glow is defeated, add threat to the main scheme equal to the printed cost of that ally and discard this card.
[star] Boost: Reveal this card.

flavor: “Your time has come. Die with honor.” –Valkyrie
name: Chooser Of The Slain
text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of your deck until an ally is discarded and put that ally into play and attach Death-Glow to that ally. Choose: • Give Valkyrie 2 facedown boost cards. • Stun and confuse your identity.

name: Visit Valhalla
text: When Revealed: The enemy team searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a Valkyrie attachment and reveals it. If Death-Glow is in play, deal indirect damage equal to the number of attachments on Valkyrie to the character with Death-Glow attached.

name: "have At Thee!"
text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The enemy team searches the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and gives 1 as a facedown boost card to Valkyrie. This card gains surge. When Revealed (Hero): Valkyrie attacks you.

name: Valhalla
text: When Defeated: The enemy team searches the encounter deck and discard pile for a Valkyrie attachment and reveals it. Valkyrie activates against the player who defeated this scheme.
